create_label: create a custom label for a project using the LabelAPI viewset endpoint
list_labels: list all custom labels added to a project via the LabelAPI viewset
update_label: update an existing custom label by its ID using the LabelAPI viewset
delete_label: delete a custom label from a project using the LabelAPI viewset
bulk_update_labels: bulk update labels in saved annotations using the LabelBulkUpdateAPI endpoint
